newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares slip, seen holding current levels.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares slip, seen holding current levels.

text.p: Slovenian shares come under a technical correction on Thursday after recent gains, but traders forecast foreign demand should buoy prices at current levels over the short term.
"Shares could fall even more if it weren't for foreign buyers. They became real market makers and many domestic traders are following them," said Davor Dubokovic, a trader at Eastbrokers.
* The SBI index fell 0.49 percent or 7.23 points to 1,469.47.
* Petrol trader Petrol was the most active, firming 0.64 percent to 22,090 tolars on volume of 11,757 shares for total turnover of 258.7 million tolars.
* Preferred shares of trading firm Kovinotehna were the top gainers, jumping 6.52 percent to 490 tolars on volume of 40 shares. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
